profile.name: Manish R Botta
profile.summary: Backend Engineer with 3+ years shipping distributed systems, data pipelines, and high-throughput APIs at production scale. Comfortable owning the full problem — from schema design to cloud deployment. Proven ability to move fast and stay reliable: Kafka pipelines at 100M+ events/day, 40% API latency cuts, and 3x release cycle improvements across fast-moving teams.

descriptions: Owned end-to-end Python data pipelines extracting, transforming, and loading structured data from internal systems into a centralized SQL store — improving downstream reporting availability by 60% with no prior pipeline infrastructure.
Automated manual data workflows using Python scripting and REST API integrations, cutting processing time by 70% and freeing the team from repetitive overhead.
Shipped containerized backend services via GitHub Actions CI/CD on Azure, achieving zero-downtime releases and cutting cross-team integration defects by 40%.
Took full ownership of Kafka-based event-driven microservices in Node.js and Python, processing 100M+ events/day across distributed infrastructure at 99.9% uptime.
Cut API response time by 40% by overhauling MySQL/MongoDB query plans, adding strategic indexes, and introducing Redis caching for hot-path data.
Built data ingestion pipelines aggregating structured and semi-structured data from 50+ enterprise client systems into unified backend stores for analytics.
Deployed Dockerized services on AWS with automated CI/CD, driving 3x faster release cycles while holding 99.9% availability for 50+ enterprise clients.
Broke apart a legacy monolith into independently deployable microservices, improving team velocity by 30% and unblocking parallel feature development.
Built RESTful APIs in Java Spring Boot with optimized SQL data access layers, cutting query response time by 40% with 80%+ test coverage via TDD.
Built auth, payments, and content-delivery REST APIs in Node.js and Python for a learning marketplace serving 1,000+ users; cut AWS infra costs 25% via S3 lifecycle policies and EC2 rightsizing.

Replaced a synchronous bottleneck with a distributed multi-stage pipeline (FastAPI + Redis queues) for ingestion, transcription, and summarization — 3x throughput gain with fault-tolerant idempotent retries.
Reduced manual review time by 80% via structured entity extraction and speaker segmentation.

Built a high-throughput service with Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, and Docker on AWS; cut DB reads by 70% and redirect latency by 60% via smart cache invalidation and JWT auth with zero-downtime deployment.
Contributed project-links feature across Next.js 13, TypeScript, and Redux Toolkit, enabling GitHub/demo URL embedding with 100% valid hyperlink rendering in exported PDFs.
